As used in this Agreement, the terms "Seller's Confidential Information" means proprietary or confidential information and business secrets of Seller pertaining to its Services Business in-cluding, without limitation, information regarding prices charged for Services, copies of existing Services contracts to which Seller is a party (other than any such contracts provided to CompuCom pursuant to the provisions of the Asset Purchase Agreement) and analyses of the amount and types of Services purchased by customers.
